projects.name: Interception-V2
projects.description: Keep an integration using the historical Interception C API.
projects.first_step: Use this edition's matching driver and SDK files for the legacy API.

projects.name: Interceptor
projects.description: Read or remap keyboard, mouse and gamepad input in one integration.
projects.first_step: Combined edition; supported hardware and device profiles are documented in its repository.

projects.name: Interceptor-Keyboard-Mouse
projects.description: Work with a selected physical keyboard or mouse.
projects.first_step: Requires driver access and explicit device selection.

projects.name: Interceptor-Gamepad-Controller
projects.description: Observe and transform reports from a supported physical gamepad.
projects.first_step: HID, XInput/XUSB and GIP coverage depends on the documented hardware and profiles.

projects.name: Windows-Input-Filter
projects.description: Integrate the Windows edition covering several input families.
projects.first_step: Follow this edition's examples and use its matching driver package.

projects.name: Windows-Gamepad-Filter
projects.description: Build a gamepad-specific integration.
projects.first_step: Check protocol and hardware support before a live test.

projects.name: Windows-Keyboard-Mouse-Filter
projects.description: Build a keyboard and mouse filter integration.
projects.first_step: Use the examples and installation instructions for this edition.

projects.name: Interceptor-MultiLang
projects.description: Integrate Interceptor from several package ecosystems.
projects.first_step: Start with the chosen wrapper's example and check its supported operations and native dependencies.

projects.name: node-interceptor
projects.description: Integrate keyboard and mouse input into Node.js or TypeScript.
projects.first_step: Specialised adapter; live use requires the Interceptor Keyboard & Mouse driver.

projects.name: FyraInput
projects.description: Find FyraInput user-mode SDK sources and packages.
projects.first_step: The package repository does not include a kernel driver or installer.

projects.name: FyraInput-Gamepad
projects.description: Find packages for the gamepad-specific FyraInput integration.
projects.first_step: Check this SDK's API and install the product dependencies separately.

projects.name: FyraInput-Keyboard-Mouse
projects.description: Find FyraInput packages for keyboard and mouse integration.
projects.first_step: Commands awaiting publication are identified in the README.

projects.name: FyraDevice
projects.description: Find FyraDevice user-mode packages.
projects.first_step: Drivers, activation and installers are supplied separately from this package repository.

projects.name: Windows-Virtual-Devices
projects.description: Create virtual USB devices using raw device descriptions.
projects.first_step: Use this edition's driver and examples; read its evaluation and UdeCx limits.

projects.name: AutoHotInterceptor
projects.description: Write AutoHotkey scripts targeting a selected keyboard or mouse.
projects.first_step: Adapted from evilC's AutoHotInterception; check attribution notices and the supported AHK versions.

projects.name: Cronus-Interceptor
projects.description: Edit and inspect GPC gamepad scripts on Windows.
projects.first_step: Independent project; read compatibility diagnostics rather than assuming every script or device works.

projects.name: Curve-Controller
projects.description: Adjust and visualise a joystick response curve.
projects.first_step: Uses Interceptor Gamepad & Controller; select supported hardware.

projects.name: GamePad-Remapper
projects.description: Configure gamepad remapping, scripts and macros.
projects.first_step: Complete example application; inspect input and output during an explicit test.

projects.name: Keyboard-Mouse-Remapper
projects.description: Edit keyboard/mouse remapping, scripts and macros.
projects.first_step: Native application with a separate matching input-driver dependency.

projects.name: MouseControl
projects.description: Run relative mouse movement code while one selected keyboard or mouse trigger is held.
projects.first_step: Code editor with move/wait and an optional loop; selecting a trigger replaces the previous one. Release cancels future movements; accepted packets cannot be recalled. Use --preview for the offline interface.

projects.name: Titan-Input-Tools
projects.description: Find the entry point for the Titan input-tool collection.
projects.first_step: Follow each component's link and its own installation guide.

projects.name: Assistive-Pointer
projects.description: Adjust gain, axes and motion for a selected mouse.
projects.first_step: Per-device adjustments; live use requires Interceptor Keyboard & Mouse.

projects.name: Controller-Repair-Bench
projects.description: Prepare a gamepad repair or QA report.
projects.first_step: Observe axes, drift and report cadence; export HTML/CSV without remapping buttons. Cadence is not end-to-end latency.

projects.name: HID-Access-Control
projects.description: Test which applications may open a selected controller.
projects.first_step: Rules apply to new opens; already-open handles keep their access.

projects.name: HID-Fixture-Studio
projects.description: Edit a HID descriptor and validate a fixture.
projects.first_step: Start with offline validation; live tests require Vdevice.

projects.name: Input-CI-Runner
projects.description: Run JSON HID-report fixtures in a test pipeline.
projects.first_step: Offline validation and explicit live runs are separate. Enqueuing a report does not prove an application consumed it.

projects.name: Input-Replay-Lab
projects.description: Record a local input sequence and replay it for authorised QA.
projects.first_step: Select one keyboard or mouse; recording and replay start explicitly. JSON/CSV exports are available.

projects.name: TitanCSA-Benchmarks
projects.description: Inspect independently received virtual-input measurements and reproduce the lab.
projects.first_step: Public Hyper-V dataset, protocol-specific results and failed runs. An open Vdevice WDF teardown incident is documented; no physical-latency or universal speed claim.

projects.name: Vdevice
projects.description: Create and control virtual USB devices through descriptors and reports.
projects.first_step: Use the matching device-family examples. Driver evaluation rights are separate from the user-mode SDK.

projects.name: Virtual-mouse-input
projects.description: Explore a specialised virtual mouse-input integration.
projects.first_step: Read this edition's report contract and dependencies.

projects.name: Serial-Device-Simulator
projects.description: Study Modbus RTU and SCPI simulation models.
projects.first_step: Source preview: live COM startup has not been validated and a VM stall was observed. Usable release binaries are withheld; not ready for production deployment.

projects.name: Virtual-COM-Workbench
projects.description: Study a CDC ACM backend and virtual serial-cable scenarios.
projects.first_step: Source preview: no real COM transfer has been validated and a VM stall was observed. Usable release binaries are withheld; not ready for production deployment.

projects.name: USB-over-IP-SDK
projects.description: Transport one selected WinUSB interface over an authenticated, encrypted connection.
projects.first_step: Bounded WinUSB bridge; not a universal redirector for arbitrary USB devices or classes.

projects.name: Titan-Audio-Link
projects.description: Connect virtual playback output to a virtual microphone input.
projects.first_step: Native PCM16 stereo at 48 kHz and a floating-point API; shared WASAPI. Exclusive capture is unsupported.

projects.name: Virtual-Camera-SDK
projects.description: Send your own images to an AVStream virtual camera.
projects.first_step: Documented contract: BGR24, 640×480, 30 fps. Driver evaluation rights are separate.

projects.name: Virtual-Display-Studio
projects.description: Explicitly connect and disconnect one virtual monitor.
projects.first_step: One 1080p60 SDR monitor, owned by the open control handle; no capture or network transport. Windows 10 build 19045 was qualified; Windows 11 and physical GPU/suspend-resume qualification remain pending.

projects.name: Remote-Workstation-SDK
projects.description: Integrate an explicitly paired Windows LAN host/viewer.
projects.first_step: Numeric IPv4, pinned TLS over TCP, GDI capture up to 1280x720 and optional SendInput in the same interactive session. No relay, secure-desktop/UAC control, audio, clipboard or file transfer. Matching runtime has a one-hour per-product/boot demo.

projects.name: Connection-Trace-Studio
projects.description: Correlate processes, addresses and WFP connection stages.
projects.first_step: Connection-lifecycle metadata; the sensor does not capture packet contents.

projects.name: Network-Emulation-SDK
projects.description: Test an application's handling of controlled UDP IPv4 impairments.
projects.first_step: Target laboratory traffic and follow the documented bounds. It is not a general TCP/bandwidth impairment tool.

projects.name: Packet-Capture-SDK
projects.description: Observe incoming/outgoing Ethernet frames on a selected adapter.
projects.first_step: Bounded capture with possible losses; layer-2 transmission is a separate operation.

projects.name: Titan-Network-Filter
projects.description: Attribute local process/port/CIDR rule decisions.
projects.first_step: Continue leaves other Windows filters in control; check behaviour on new flows.

projects.name: Virtual-Network-Adapter-SDK
projects.description: Integrate a virtual network adapter into an application.
projects.first_step: Read the packet contract, lifecycle and driver requirements.

projects.name: Remote-Device-Control
projects.description: Control an unlocked Windows console desktop through a dedicated host and portable viewer.
projects.first_step: Direct Sunshine/Moonlight SDR H.264 up to 1080p; Vdevice supplies host-side keyboard/mouse input with its one-hour kernel-boot demo. No relay fallback, secure-desktop control, audio, clipboard/file transfer or gamepad forwarding.

projects.name: Advanced-Network-Filtering-SDK
projects.description: Apply scoped WFP IPv4/IPv6 application, CIDR, protocol and port rules.
projects.first_step: Native C++17 SDK and signed evaluation bundle. A one-hour kernel-boot allowance applies; this component is not a complete VPN.

projects.name: Changed-Block-Tracking-SDK
projects.description: Obtain conservative changed-block maps and checkpoints.
projects.first_step: Evaluate on an explicitly selected synthetic disk and follow the checkpoint protocol.

projects.name: Cloud-Files-SDK
projects.description: Hydrate Windows files on demand from an application backend.
projects.first_step: Read-only backend, required runtime and limited demo; check CFAPI scope.

projects.name: File-Trace-Studio
projects.description: Explore per-process file I/O completion diagnostics.
projects.first_step: Preview: Microsoft altitude assignment, signing and live qualification remain pending in the documentation.

projects.name: Storage-IO-Flight-Recorder
projects.description: Observe statuses and completions on the laboratory's synthetic disk.
projects.first_step: Initially select an unpartitioned lab disk; software measurements do not establish physical-drive latency.

projects.name: Titan-File-Filter
projects.description: Explore audit/access rules scoped to folders.
projects.first_step: Engineering preview: altitude, signing and live validation pending. No installable production-protection driver is provided.

projects.name: User-Backed-Virtual-Disk-SDK
projects.description: Supply a user-mode backend for a virtual disk.
projects.first_step: Follow the driver's contract, lifecycle and bounded-request rules.

projects.name: Virtual-Storage-Fault-Lab
projects.description: Test error handling on a disposable RAM disk.
projects.first_step: Synthetic test fixture; distinguish an accepted injection, an I/O result and filesystem state. It does not establish power-loss durability.

projects.name: Driver-Readiness-Inspector
projects.description: Prepare device and driver-service support reports.
projects.first_step: Read-only HTML/JSON exports; this utility requires no additional driver. It is not a driver updater.

projects.name: Latency-inspector
projects.description: Explore Windows timing and load observations.
projects.first_step: Read the measurement definitions; software timestamps are not hardware latency measurements.

projects.name: Process-Trace-Studio
projects.description: Observe attributed process events.
projects.first_step: Check event coverage and live-collection requirements.

projects.name: ProcessGuard-SDK
projects.description: Audit or deny direct launches belonging to an application.
projects.first_step: Scoped to the owning client and its rules; an integration component rather than a complete antivirus.

projects.name: RegistryGuard
projects.description: Explore write rules for an application registry branch.
projects.first_step: Preview: altitude allocation, signing and live qualification pending. Scope: HKLM\SOFTWARE.

projects.name: USB-Trace-SDK
projects.description: Observe USB-request metadata and bounded payload samples.
projects.first_step: Explicitly select one USB device; check supported transfers and capture limits.

projects.name: Browser-Control-SDK
projects.description: Control a local WebView2 browser through an application SDK or MCP tools.
projects.first_step: Navigation, inspection, forms and screenshots; Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime is required. This is browser automation, not whole-desktop control.

projects.name: Titan-Local-AI
projects.description: Use a French desktop interface for local GGUF text models.
projects.first_step: Acquire model weights separately. File/browser tools depend on the model, with confirmation by default.

projects.name: Scanner-Route
projects.description: Validate a prefix and export USB HID barcode scans to local CSV.
projects.first_step: US-ASCII keyboard-wedge scanner plus Enter; live use requires Interceptor Keyboard & Mouse.
